Meet Ruth I’m Ruth Ferguson, and I’m running to keep City College affordable for everyone. I grew up in a struggling rural town where community college was the door that opened everything for me and my family, and it carried me all the way to a four-year university and a master’s in public policy from UC Berkeley. Since being appointed to the City College Board of Trustees in January, I’ve hit the ground running. I voted for the board’s resolution supporting Free City, spoke up for it at the DCCC, and appealed directly to city supervisors to push for restoring its funding. I voted to approve a balanced budget that protects the college’s finances and have spent the past several months listening to students, faculty, staff, and neighbors so their priorities shape what the board does next. City College of San Francisco is a place where every San Franciscan can find economic opportunity, exploration, and reinvention. I’m proof of what community college can do, and I’m proud to do that work from a seat on the board. Learn More Join Ruth & Donate Today!

## Meet Ruth
I’m Ruth Ferguson, and I’m running to keep City College affordable for everyone. I grew up in a struggling rural town where community college was the door that opened everything for me and my family, and it carried me all the way to a four-year university and a master’s in public policy from UC Berkeley.
Since being appointed to the City College Board of Trustees in January, I’ve hit the ground running. I voted for the board’s resolution supporting Free City, spoke up for it at the DCCC, and appealed directly to city supervisors to push for restoring its funding. I voted to approve a balanced budget that protects the college’s finances and have spent the past several months listening to students, faculty, staff, and neighbors so their priorities shape what the board does next.
City College of San Francisco is a place where every San Franciscan can find economic opportunity, exploration, and reinvention. I’m proof of what community college can do, and I’m proud to do that work from a seat on the board.
